Replace this text with the paper. The `.qmd` is the source of truth; this file also builds a Word
document for co-authors to edit with tracked changes:

1. A co-author downloads `paper.docx` (from the [Other Formats](#) menu on the HTML page) and edits it in Word with Track Changes on.
2. Copy each accepted change back into this file by hand. To see them quickly:
   `pandoc --track-changes=all -t markdown paper.docx`.
3. Commit the `.qmd`. The next build replaces the docx.

A citation looks like this [@peng2011].
